'''Empire's Station I''' was [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] belonging to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Empire's Station I was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
